title: krn task create refuses a body that fails a task-quality rule
body:
Why: lead created t-zdcrewe with krn task create; the task-quality rule measurable-outcome turned main red after #1016 merged (lane npm-row-workflows PR #1017 blocked).
Outcome: krn task create and krn task edit exit non-zero with the measurable-outcome message when the body violates a task-quality rule, so a bad record never reaches a commit.
Files: src/task/cli.ts, src/brain/task-quality.ts, test/cli/task-quality.test.ts or the task cli test.
Proof: a test where create with an unmeasurable Outcome exits non-zero and writes no tasks/*.json; a measurable one exits 0.
